name: Atezolizumab
route_note: IV infusion every 2, 3 or 4 weeks; subcutaneous form with hyaluronidase

discovery.note: Humanised IgG1 anti-PD-L1 antibody with an engineered Fc (N297A) that abolishes effector function.

tagline: First PD-L1 inhibitor, used in lung, liver and other cancers
summary: Atezolizumab is a humanised monoclonal antibody that blocks PD-L1, the main ligand of the PD-1 checkpoint. It was the first PD-L1 inhibitor approved and is used in non-small cell and small cell lung cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, melanoma and alveolar soft part sarcoma.
mechanism: Atezolizumab binds PD-L1 (CD274) on tumour and immune cells, blocking its interaction with PD-1 and with B7.1 (CD80), and so relieving suppression of anti-tumour T cells.
Unlike PD-1 antibodies it leaves the PD-L2–PD-1 interaction intact. Its Fc region is engineered to lack effector function so that PD-L1-expressing activated T cells are not depleted.
uses: Non-small cell lung cancer (adjuvant and metastatic)
Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (with carboplatin and etoposide)
BRAF V600-mutant melanoma (with cobimetinib and vemurafenib)

history.title: First PD-L1 approval
history.detail: FDA grants accelerated approval in May for urothelial carcinoma.

history.title: Lung cancer
history.detail: Approved for previously treated metastatic NSCLC (OAK).

history.title: Small cell lung cancer
history.detail: Approved with chemotherapy for extensive-stage SCLC after IMpower133 — the first immunotherapy advance in that disease in decades.

history.title: Liver cancer
history.detail: Approved with bevacizumab for unresectable HCC (IMbrave150).

history.title: Adjuvant NSCLC
history.detail: Approved as adjuvant therapy for PD-L1-positive resected NSCLC (IMpower010).

history.title: Urothelial indication withdrawn
history.detail: The remaining US bladder cancer indication is withdrawn after confirmatory trials.

history.title: Subcutaneous form
history.detail: FDA approves Tecentriq Hybreza with hyaluronidase.

pk.metabolism: Proteolytic catabolism to peptides and amino acids (no CYP metabolism)
pk.excretion: Not renally excreted as intact antibody; cleared by catabolism and target-mediated uptake

serious: Immune-mediated endocrinopathies (thyroiditis, hypophysitis, adrenal insufficiency, type 1 diabetes)

facts: Its triple-negative breast cancer indication was withdrawn in the US in 2021 after IMpassion131 failed to confirm benefit.
It was the first PD-L1-directed antibody approved by any regulator.
